clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Yvette Farthing shares the Gallows' End Tavern with her father, Coleman. A Forsaken, she carries the memory of a love cut short by the Scourge.

Yvette loved Thurman Agamand, heir to the prosperous Agamand Mills, before the Third War ruined Lordaeron. As the Scourge plague drew near, Yvette and her father, Coleman, begged Thurman to leave the estate with them. He refused, devoted to his family's legacy. Yvette and Thurman both perished and rose into undeath. Yvette found a place among the free-willed Forsaken in Brill, but she did not know Thurman's final fate.
